arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose id is a multiple of 100, which is about 1% of all transactions, selected without regard to amount, card, merchant or type.
assumptions: 'Random' is implemented as a fixed id-based sample (id modulo 100 = 0) rather than SQLite random(), so the same transactions are flagged on every run and the review set is reproducible.
The sample is about 1% of all transactions by id, not exactly 1% of any date range or segment.
The rule does not use fraud labels, so it is a review sample, not a fraud-detection pattern.
